summary_en: 210,000 shares (1.60% S/O) to be acquired via ToSTNeT-3 at ¥939/share (closing price 2026-07-14), upper limit ¥197.19M. Settlement 2026-07-15. All acquired shares to be cancelled 2026-07-27.
title_en: Notice regarding acquisition of treasury shares and purchase of treasury shares via off-floor trading (ToSTNeT-3), and cancellation of treasury shares
translation_en_brief: Wesco Holdings resolved at its board meeting on 2026-07-14 to acquire up to 210,000 shares of its own common stock and thereafter cancel all acquired shares. The acquisition will be executed via ToSTNeT-3 off-floor block trading on 2026-07-15 at the closing price of ¥939/share from 2026-07-14 (including final special indicative prices), representing an upper limit of ¥197.19M. The acquisition order is valid only during the specified trading window and will not be rerouted to other trading systems or times. The company stated that market conditions may result in partial or no execution. All shares acquired will be cancelled on 2026-07-27. The stated rationale is to enhance capital efficiency and conduct agile capital policy to improve shareholder returns. As of 2026-07-14, the company held 68,681 treasury shares against 13,141,319 shares outstanding (ex-treasury).
